description: This file defines the internal class AdoNetBatchContainer which implements the IBatchContainer interface for the Orleans streaming ADONET provider. It handles serialization, deserialization, and management of batch container data including events, request context, sequence tokens, and message conversion functionalities.

classes.name: AdoNetBatchContainer
classes.description: The implementation of IBatchContainer tailored for ADONET provider, supporting binary serialization, event retrieval, and message conversion.

methods.name: FromMessage
methods.description: Creates an AdoNetBatchContainer instance from an AdoNetStreamMessage using a serializer.

methods.name: ToMessagePayload
methods.description: Serializes AdoNetBatchContainer data into a byte array suitable for message payload.
